questions.q: Why is F1 defined as a harmonic mean rather than a simple average of precision and recall?
options: It is easier to compute
It is pulled toward the smaller value, so weak recall cannot hide behind strong precision
It always equals accuracy
It ignores false negatives
questions.explain: The harmonic mean punishes imbalance between the two numbers. With precision 0.516 and recall 0.271, the plain average is 0.394 but F1 is only 0.356.

questions.q: What do the axes of an ROC curve show?
options: Precision on x, recall on y
Accuracy on x, F1 on y
Threshold on x, AUC on y
False positive rate on x, true positive rate on y
questions.explain: The ROC curve plots true positive rate (recall) against false positive rate as the cutoff sweeps from strict to permissive.

questions.q: What is the practical meaning of an AUC of 0.745?
options: The model is 74.5% accurate
74.5% of positives are found at the default threshold
A randomly chosen positive is scored higher than a randomly chosen negative about 74.5% of the time
The model makes 25.5% false positives
questions.explain: AUC is the probability that a random positive outranks a random negative. It summarizes ranking quality over all thresholds, not accuracy at one.

questions.q: In the lesson, the forest had a lower AUC than logistic regression but a higher F1 at the default cutoff. Why is that possible?
options: AUC judges the ranking across all thresholds, while F1 judges a single operating point
One of the two metrics was computed incorrectly
Random forests cannot produce probabilities
F1 is computed on the training set only
questions.explain: AUC ignores the cutoff; F1 depends on it. A model can rank slightly worse overall yet happen to have a better trade-off at 0.5.

questions.q: A retention team wants to find as many churners as possible and can tolerate false alarms. Which metric best reflects that priority?
options: F-beta with beta = 0.5
Accuracy
Specificity
F-beta with beta = 2
questions.explain: Beta = 2 weights recall more heavily than precision, matching a priority on catching churners over avoiding false alarms.
